subject: Post-demo alignment: ROI snapshot, security gate items & sell-through plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo alignment: ROI snapshot, security gate items & sell-through plan

Team — quick recap from today's demo with FinWell (Alex + Priya on the call):

Highlights / decision signals:
- Economic buyer (Alex Johnson) is focused on predictable unit economics: wants a 12-month TCO projection that compares our hosted vs dedicated options (he called out latency at 50–75ms p50 as a must).
- Security lead (Priya Sharma) flagged two gating items: SOC 2 attestation and a clear data retention & audit-log approach for customer-managed keys.
- Procurement timeline: procurement expects to start contract review 10/18 with a target SOW sign by end of November if there are no surprises.

Immediate asks / owners: 
- Dylan: run a technical deep-dive (SREs + FinWell infra) and produce a short preflight checklist for Priya (networking, KMS integration, audit log format) — target: schedule wk of 10/4.
- Marissa: draft pricing scenarios and a one-page TCO comparing hosted vs dedicated (include token-cost assumptions + reserved commit examples). See attached "roi-worksheet.xlsx" for initial numbers.
- Grace: prepare an internal onboarding outline + success metrics we can propose (30/60/90) so Alex can take this to ops.

Other notes: Alex is our internal champion but will need crisp ROI math and a talk track to justify a paid pilot to his CFO. He said procurement will ask for a list of subcontractors and an audit contact.

Attachments: finwell-demo-notes.pdf (call notes), roi-worksheet.xlsx (starter TCO).

Next steps: please reply with:
1) proposed owner-confirmation (who will do what)
2) any missing asks I should collect from the customer ahead of the deep-dive

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo alignment: ROI snapshot, security gate items & sell-through plan

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. I can take the lead on pricing/TCO. A few tactical notes: 

- I'll produce two scenarios: (A) 6-month paid pilot on Hosted API (metered, no commit) with a play-to-dedicated clause; (B) 12-month Dedicated commit with burst capacity and a defined latency SLA.
- Need clarity on expected throughput (peak rps) and typical sequence length — Alex gave an estimate of ~600k tokens/day during pilot and peak 2.5M tokens/day post-launch. If Dylan can confirm those numbers during the deep-dive we can finalize the commit tiers.
- Discount guidance: for initial pilot we can offer up to 15% on list for the first 3 months; any larger concession needs manager approval. Can you loop in finance if Procurement presses for a larger credit?

I'll update the roi-worksheet.xlsx and drop a short one-pager for Alex that frames the payback period (expected < 5 months under scenario B) for his CFO.

On internal ask: we should also give Alex a short "talk track" doc (1 page) that highlights cost savings vs in-house inference and our fallback policies if latency spikes. I'll draft that once Dylan confirms perf assumptions.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa — I'll own the tech deep-dive and the security preflight. Proposed plan: 

1) Pre-call doc (I'll share before the deep-dive): short checklist for Priya covering KMS flow, audit-log schema, retention defaults, IP/data flow diagram, and our SOC2 controls relevant to data handling. I'll attach the SOC2 highlights we typically send (soc2-summary.pdf).
2) Deep-dive attendees: Dylan (me, infra), two SREs, FinWell SREs (TBD), and one engineer from product for model/quantization questions.
3) Time estimate: 60–75 minutes. Need confirmation from Alex for a 10/6 or 10/7 slot.

A couple of items for pricing that impact perf: quantization/FP precision will affect latency and cost — I'll include a quick matrix in the pre-call doc. Also will ask FinWell for a sample request profile (sequence length histogram) so Marissa can finalize the TCO.

Attachment: soc2-summary.pdf (high-level SOC2 points we can share).

—Dylan

Subject: Next steps and materials (ROI worksheet + SOC2 summary)

Alex / Priya — following up with the internal plan we discussed. Quick readout and next steps: 

What we're sending you this week:
- ROI worksheet (attached) — Marissa will update with the two pricing scenarios we discussed.
- SOC2 highlights (attached) — Dylan included the most relevant controls for data handling and audit logs.

Action items we propose (for clarity):
1) Alex: confirm expected pilot throughput and a preferred window for the deep-dive (10/6 or 10/7 work for you?). Also please share a sample request profile if available (histogram of sequence lengths).
2) Priya: please confirm if a SOC2 summary + our KMS diagram will be enough for initial procurement review or if you want our SOC2 report sent to your security team directly. If they require a formal auditor contact, I can connect teams.
3) Procurement: aiming to start contract review 10/18 — Marissa will prep a draft SOW and pricing attachment for review.

If helpful, Marissa will also send a one-page "advocacy" note you can use to brief the CFO (payback, pilot terms, accountability for success metrics).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: roi-worksheet.xlsx, soc2-summary.pdf
